title: Crispy Tofu & Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: Pan-fried pressed tofu in a garlic-ginger sauce with charred broccoli and cashews.
ingredients: 400 g firm tofu, pressed and cubed
steps: Press the tofu, then fry until golden on all sides and set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli until the edges char, then return the tofu.
Add the sauce, toss to coat, and finish with cashews and scallions.
notes: Pressing the tofu well before cooking is the single biggest factor in getting a crisp result.
